note: What a server sends to move a marker (SpawnMarker) from one place toward another. The header names the marker. A client sets it at the start at once.

fields.name: fromX
fields.note: Where it starts, in world units.

fields.name: fromZ
fields.note: Where it starts, in world units.

fields.name: toX
fields.note: Where it goes, in world units.

fields.name: toZ
fields.note: Where it goes, in world units.

fields.name: speed
fields.note: How fast it goes, in world units a second. Below zero it jumps to the goal; zero leaves it at the start.

fields.name: faceGoal
fields.note: One to turn it the way it moves, zero not to.
